description.tagline: Control y comodidad para dar sus primeros pasos
description.intro: The Nike Jr Phantom 6 Low Club FG/MG LK Haaland small child football boots are designed for growing players looking for comfort, control and safety during the game. Its flexible synthetic upper fits the foot and favors close contact with the ball, while the new structure provides a more natural fit, especially on the toe. The FG/MG sole offers the traction needed to move confidently on natural and artificial surfaces.
key_benefits: Control with confidence: The flexible upper brings the foot closer to the ball to promote precise contact during controls, passes and hits.
More natural fit: The new structure adapts to the shape of the foot, especially in the toe, to comfortably accompany growing players.
Cleaner hits: The construction of the cut favors direct contact with the ball to execute each action safely.
Comfort during the game: The cushioned template helps keep a comfortable feeling while enjoying their first matches and workouts.
Versatile traction: The configuration of the sole favors quick movements and secure support on natural and artificial surfaces.
